formula.text: LIVE flip incentive: for each published probe pair (E→E_next), join DISPATCH-selected (miner, task_index) at E with private probe per_task at E and E_next. Eligibility default=hard_fail (baseline status in unresolved|wrong|error). Credit fail→pass by surprise w=-log(p_hat) (or 1/p_hat); optional debit pass→fail by surprise on (1-p_hat). p_hat from running EMA of prior probe pass rates (alpha), else bandit ema_p, else raw pass at E. Shares = relu(flip_score)/sum. No authenticity *bonus* (no_authenticity_guard). TOPLOC/sampling verify fail strips flip credit; unverified earns nothing when credit_requires_verify_pass. Applied to on-chain mech-0 weights. Hard nonzero floor: if gates would all-zero shares, preserve last good scores shares (else uniform over recent DISPATCH miners).
